live_pr.body:
This investigation does not resolve Bigelow’s algebraic-coefficient faithful-representation problem for n≥4. The verified partial records restriction of scalars with increased degree, finite-set versus all-word specialization, an explicit universal countermodel to automatic algebraic specialization, and the correct rational representation for three strands. No novelty or general nonexistence claim is made.

The current source audit qualifies Scherich’s printed Example3.11 parameter, which is not Salem as printed, without claiming its image nondiscrete or conflating the general discreteness theorem with faithfulness. Original source/proof/review/checkpoint bytes are preserved; the correct source-context readiness hash and original1/5 ledger remain unchanged. Three independent families and root reproduce the checks; a NEW complete review of the corrected package is pending.

The original PR changes14 files in the problem’s attempt directory and the single matching QUEUE.md status row. Corrected current findings will be integrated on main only after the full gate passes, followed by a source-bound accepted-state mirror. AI tools were used extensively in this project’s research and verification; the work is unrefereed. No paper, new DOI or publication-tracker row is created for this unsolved partial.
